stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Why was a week of fares wrong?

stations.title: The programs
stations.text: The adult fare typed in four places

stations.title: Harbour office
stations.text: Checks each ticket by its number.

captions: The ticket roll at the hut. Bridie wants numbered tickets and one adult fare.
The fare is typed in four places, and last spring one of them was missed.
You write a count every ticket shares, a fare kept once, and each ticket's line.
Now every ticket has its own number, and a new fare is one change in one line.
static, static final and why main is static. Next: more than one file.
